glosses: fortress; fortification; stronghold (a large place built to withstand attacks)
bulwark; stronghold (something that offers protection, especially in a psychological sense)
fortitude; inner strength (emotional strength in the face of adversity)

examples.text: Contos de docilidade, de honra, de justiça, de coragem, de fortaleza perante o sofrimento, de intrepidez perante o perigo, de resolução destemida, de vontade de ferro inspiram as crianças a uma emulação dessas virtudes.
examples.en: Tales of gentleness, of honor, of justice, of courage, of fortitude in suffering, of intrepidity in danger, of dauntless resolution, of iron will, inspire children to an emulation of those virtues.
